attribution.note: The twelve skill notes study the public agent skills of Graphed (graphed.com) from its public index, public pages, and one independent walkthrough, read November 16, 2026. No vendor prompt text is copied; capabilities are described in the author's own words, and inferences are labeled as unverified. Each note splits Part A (what Graphed's skill does, public, sourced) from Part B (the author's redesign). Nothing implies Graphed endorsement. The pack's commands use the /aarucien:* namespace, never the researched vendor's.
